cohort: A Tunisian family including a 5-year-old female proband with severe HCM, her parents, and siblings across two generations.
finding: A novel homozygous MRPL44 gene variant (c.198_205delinsTA; p.(Trp66_His69 delinsCysAsn)) was identified and associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in a Tunisian family.
